text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer. It's Happy Valentine's Day, 
but...

Even though it was Valentine's Day, Super 
Creek's mood was unusually low.

When I asked if she had forgotten the 
chocolate:

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's not it at all~ I actually brought 
homemade chocolate, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Even so...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Could you please try it? Just a single 
bite to start.

I placed one of the handed chocolates into 
my mouth. And then—!

A heavenly, sublime taste... It was the 
flavor of Super Creek giving it her all.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Was it delicious?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Please don't die~

The taste seems completely fine. So why is 
their mood so down?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Umm, well, when I poured my feelings into 
making chocolate... and finally finished 
it, a thought suddenly struck me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what kind of chocolate is this 
supposed to be?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um~, there are all kinds, right? Honmei 
choco, tomo choco, giri choco...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I've lost track of the feelings I poured 
into it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's not it at all~ If I had to say, 
it's closer to honmei chocolate. But...

No answer comes. Because that is not the 
kind of relationship an Umamusume and 
Trainer share.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm, if I had to say, this is...

Some bonds can't quite be put into words. 
So when I explained it as "some kind of 
chocolate"...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's true. But having only a little bit 
feels a little lonely~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Would it be okay even if it's 'some kind 
of special chocolate'?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Phew... I feel a bit better now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"You're right, there are some 
relationships where you just can't put 
into words how precious they are."

Watched over with smiles, I ate the 
chocolate. It tasted of something truly 
precious.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Honmei chocolate is just the chocolate 
you give to the person you love, right?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I don't take it lightly at all.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're the only one for me, in 
the past and in the future.

True, I'm not really sure what kind of 
chocolate this is supposed to be. A 
relationship where we entrust our lives to 
each other as we run is just too heavy.

After thinking about it for tens of 
minutes, I blurted out, "Whatever 
chocolate is fine!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Huh, any chocolate is fine? Trainer, don't 
be like that~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~? But yeah, you're right. Maybe any 
kind of chocolate will do...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure words could never truly describe 
it. Our relationship, that is."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Nobody else understood, but we knew it 
deep down...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, fufufufu. And yet both of you are 
agonizing over it. It's quite amusing, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thinking that hard must have made 
you hungry.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Please, have some chocolate. It's the only 
one of its kind in the whole world.

The chocolate tasted... of a true 
encounter, something no ordinary couple 
could ever experience.
